versions.changelog: New icon. The shared helper keeps its connection file private, clears update records on the last disconnect, and keeps the network route you chose when an update check fails.
Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

unattended-live-avatar 0.1.1

- Initial release of unattended-live-avatar skill.
- Generates loopable talking-avatar clips (welcome, product, FAQ, close) for unattended or overnight shop livestreams.
- Inspects and verifies portrait and speech rights, handles authorized likeness and voice cloning with explicit user consent.
- Supports both custom voice cloning and catalog voice selection, with clear confirmation and billing steps.
- Produces video clips from supplied or synthesized speech, with detailed error handling and recovery instructions.
- Designed for unattended digital human livestreams, night-shift avatars, and shop loop presenters.
